Package midtermlabproject2

Class InfixToPostfix

java.lang.Object
midtermlabproject2.InfixToPostfix
public class InfixToPostfix extends Object
Converts an infix expression to postfix using a LinkedStack of operators and the incoming/in-stack priority (icp/isp) scheme from Module 3.

Priorities:

 token     icp   isp
 operand    0     -
 + -        1     2
 * /        3     4
 ^          6     5    (icp > isp => right-to-left associativity)
 (          7     0

Infix input must contain no spaces. Operands are letters or numbers (for example A, 12, 3.5); operators are + - * / ^ and parentheses. Each step of a conversion is recorded as a Row so the trace table can be printed with TablePrinter.

Example: ((A-(B+C))*D)^(E+F) becomes A B C + - D * E F + ^.

See Also:

    • flushOperand

      private static void flushOperand(StringBuilder operand, List<String> tokens) throws InvalidExpressionException
      Moves any operand collected so far into the token list and resets the buffer. Does nothing if the buffer is empty.
      Parameters:
      operand - the buffer holding the operand being read
      tokens - the token list to append to

    • validate

      static void validate(List<String> tokens) throws InvalidExpressionException
      Checks that operands and operators alternate correctly and that parentheses are balanced.
      Parameters:
      tokens - the tokens produced by tokenize(String)
      Throws:
      InvalidExpressionException - if the expression is empty, has a missing operand or operator, ends with an operator, or has unbalanced parentheses

    • convert

      public String convert(String infix) throws InvalidExpressionException
      Converts an infix expression to postfix. The trace table is available afterwards through getRows(); any state from a previous call is discarded.
      Parameters:
      infix - the infix expression, with no spaces
      Returns:
      the postfix expression, with tokens separated by single spaces
      Throws:
      InvalidExpressionException - if the expression is invalid (see tokenize(String) and validate(List))
